examples.label: long text, two lines
examples.source: Behaviors decorate real elements in light DOM. There is no build step: the browser loads native ES modules directly. There is no shadow root, so every style and query reaches every element. There is no base class either: a behavior is a function applied to an element, and several can be applied to the same one. This paragraph is long enough to need more than two lines at any width the stage can have.

examples.label: long text, five lines
examples.source: Behaviors decorate real elements in light DOM. There is no build step: the browser loads native ES modules directly. There is no shadow root, so every style and query reaches every element. There is no base class either: a behavior is a function applied to an element, and several can be applied to the same one. This paragraph is long enough to need more than five lines at any width the stage can have, so the clamp shows. It keeps going with one more sentence, and then another, and then a final one to be sure the fifth line ends in an ellipsis.
